'''Kiughfids''' was a card game that was played at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Four-armed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] served as dealers in the club.<ref name="Complete Locations" />
